svg.title: The effect of the i and g flags
svg.desc: The text Day one, then Monday and Sunday tested with four variations of the pattern day: with no flags, only the day inside Monday matches; with i, only the Day at the start; with g, the day in Monday and in Sunday; with gi, all three.
svg.text: The effect of the i and g flags
The same pattern, four different results
i ignores case; still first only: 1
Without g, the search stops at the first match; without i, “Day” and “day” are different texts.
